title: fix(service-messaging): a notification digest's heading is rendered in its recipient's language
body:
Fixes #25015

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this does

A notification digest of two or more items was headed "You have N notifications", an English literal built in `digest-render.ts`, for every recipient whatever their language. Its items were already rendered in the recipient's language (PR #25014), so a zh-CN recipient read zh-CN items under an English heading.

The heading is now keyed and rendered by the `EmitInput.keyedText` renderer, the same one and the same locale read as the items. There is no second mechanism.

- **The key.** `messages.notificationDigestTitle`, with a `{{count}}` hole, in `@objectstack/service-messaging`'s own translation bundle (`MessagingTranslations`). It ships in every locale the bundle ships: en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES. The bundle gains a hand-authored `messages` face (`src/translations/messages.ts`), in the shape the approvals and audit plugins use for their notification sentences. The plugin's existing `kernel:ready` hook loads it with the rest of the bundle.
- **The render.** `NotificationDispatcher.processDigestGroup` now builds the digest through `localizedDigest()`. For a group of two or more, the heading (`digestHeading(count)`: the key, its `{{count}}`, and the literal) goes to `NotificationTextRenderer.renderAllFor` in the same call as the group's items. So one locale read covers the group: `sys_user.locale`, then the deployment default (#13881). It is negotiated against the `i18n` service's locales by the renderer's existing `resolveBundleLocale` step.
- **The literal fallback.** It is the `en` entry interpolated, byte for byte the old sentence ("You have 3 notifications"). A recipient reads it with no `i18n` service, with no renderer composed, or when the catalog has no entry in any locale it consults. In that last case the renderer's existing miss warning is said once per key and locale.
- **Unchanged.** A one-item digest is titled by its item, as before. The digest body (the item list), the payload (`digest`, `count`, `items`) and the actor rule are untouched. No export, option or type changes. `renderDigest` is internal and only gains an optional `heading` argument.

## Why no plural mechanism was needed (PM assumption 2, measured)

Neither `II18nService` implementation selects a plural form. `createMemoryI18n().t()` (`packages/core/src/fallbacks/memory-i18n.ts`) and `FileI18nAdapter.t()` (`packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.ts`) both interpolate `{{name}}` holes and nothing else. The renderer carries the count as an ordinary string param. That is enough because the heading is only ever rendered for a count of two or more. In each of the four shipped locales, every count from two up takes one form: en and es-ES use the plural, and zh-CN and ja-JP do not inflect. So no new mechanism was added, and there is no gap to report for the shipped locales. A locale whose form varies above two (Polish, Russian, Arabic) would need plural selection in the `i18n` service. That is recorded under Acceptance notes and in `messages.ts`, and not built.

## Where the producer is (PM assumption 1, measured on `06900c9c2`)

- Confirmed: `digest-render.ts:43` held the literal, and `NotificationDispatcher.processDigestGroup` (`dispatcher.ts:286`) reached it for every digest group of two or more rows. The fix lands there, in the declared file surface.
- PM assumption 2 also holds: PR #25014's path is on `main` (`notification-text.ts`; `readNotificationTextKeys` at `dispatcher.ts:347` and `:382`). Its renderer is reused unchanged.
- PM assumption 3 also holds: the bundle ships en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES, and the key is added in all four.

## The cost change

With an `i18n` service registered, a digest of two or more items now reads its recipient's locale once even when none of its items is keyed, because its heading always is. Before, such a group read nothing. That is one read per group per window, on a path that already reads the same row for email and SMS addresses. The cost note in `notification-text.ts` says so.

## Pins

All pins are in `packages/services/service-messaging/src/keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts`, a new `#25015` block of seven cases. They run on the file's existing real stack: ObjectQL over SqlDriver (better-sqlite3), the kernel's in-memory `i18n` holding this package's real `MessagingTranslations` (loaded the way the plugin's `kernel:ready` hook loads it), the real `MessagingService`, the inbox and email channels, the memory outbox, and the dispatcher.

1. A zh-CN recipient's three-item digest is headed `您有 3 条通知` over three zh-CN items, in the inbox row and in the mail subject.
2. Control: the English recipient of the same digest reads `You have 2 notifications`.
3. A recipient with no locale reads the deployment default (ja-JP): `2 件の通知があります`.
4. A recipient whose language no pack holds (fr-FR) reads the deployment default's pack (zh-CN).
5. When neither the recipient's language nor the deployment default has a pack, the recipient reads the English literal, and the miss is said once.
6. A one-item digest keeps its item's own title, rendered in zh-CN, with no heading.
7. Every shipped locale carries every messaging sentence with the same `{{holes}}`, and `MessagingTranslations` serves exactly those entries per locale.

The existing `digest.test.ts` cases, with no renderer composed, still read `You have 3 notifications` and `You have 2 notifications`. They are the byte-unchanged pin for the literal.

## Ablation (one-off, no permanent file)

Run on head `490c66405` with the fix committed (the package is byte-identical at the final head `0d56c868d`), through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the verify lock. The mutation was in `dispatcher.ts`: `return renderDigest(localized, heading ? rendered[rows.length].title : undefined);` became `return renderDigest(localized, undefined);`, which drops the keyed heading. On disk: anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob `a404506aa183` to `afccb98e9e01`.

- Result: the expected direction, red. `Tests 3 failed | 14 passed (17)`. Pins 1, 3 and 4 went red (`expected 'You have 2 notifications' to be '2 件の通知があります'`, and the same shape for zh-CN). The English control, the literal fallback, the one-item pin and the parity pin stayed green, as they should.
- Restore: blob after restore `a404506aa183` equals the blob at HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

Tests import the package source (`./dispatcher.js`) directly, not a built `dist/`, so no rebuild was part of either leg.

## Tests

The final head is `0d56c868d`: the fix (`06a8ce4ef`) and its changeset (`490c66405`), with `origin/main` `425c743fd` merged in. That merge brought one commit touching only `plugin-auth`. `git diff 490c66405 0d56c868d -- packages/services/service-messaging` is empty. The dependency closure was built first (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/service-messaging^...' build`, exit 0), then the package itself.

- On `0d56c868d`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test`: `Test Files 55 passed (55)`, `Tests 617 passed (617)`.
- On `0d56c868d`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json`): exit 0. The package tsconfig includes `src`, so the test files are compiled.
- Targeted, on `490c66405`: `vitest run src/keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts src/digest.test.ts` gave `Tests 26 passed (26)`.

## Gates (local subset; CI runs the full farm)

- **Derived list.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final head `0d56c868d` derived 68 commands, the same list as on `490c66405`. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe. Result: all 68 exited 0. That includes `pnpm check:i18n` ("all bundles in sync", `services/service-messaging in sync (7 bundle(s))`), `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:published-files`, `pnpm check:dts-closure`, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `pnpm check:type-check-coverage` and the changeset gates.
- **Reconciliation.** `--ran` gave "68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a derived zero because every line records its exit code.
- **First round.** On `490c66405`, two gates exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `check:i18n` (the CLI was not built) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (workspace dist missing). The prerequisite closure that `check:i18n` names was then built, and both read 0 in the final-head round above.
- **Not run locally.** The CI-owned jobs `dispatch-gates` names outside the 68 (Test Core shards, Build Core, the type-check lanes) are left to CI. So are the repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint`). The `test:repo` project is not touched by this diff.

## Published surface (Clause-② measurement)

`src/index.ts` is unchanged, so the `.` entry exports nothing new. In the built `dist/index.d.ts`, the new names (`digestHeading`, `DIGEST_HEADING_KEY`, `messagingMessages`) appear only once, inside a doc comment on a private member. No export, type or option moves. The built `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs` now carry the catalog sentence: a runtime string loaded into the `i18n` service, not an accept set or an export. So the line stays `Clause-②: no`, with `Metadata-protocol: none` because nothing a metadata author writes changes. The changeset is a `patch` on `@objectstack/service-messaging`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Plural selection (dormant, carrier: none).** The `i18n` service interpolates `{{name}}` only and has no plural selection. That is enough for every locale shipped today, because the digest heading's count is always two or more. It would not be enough for a locale whose plural form varies above two. No such locale ships, and nothing reads one.
- **Item title fallback (observation, carrier: none).** `renderDigest` still titles an item with neither a title nor a topic as the English `Notification`. It is unreachable through `emit()`, because `EmitInput.topic` is required and is snapshotted onto every delivery row. It is not changed here.
- **File surface.** As declared in claim 6331845950: `digest-render.ts`, the bundle (`translations/index.ts`, plus the new `translations/messages.ts`), the keyed-text reader (`dispatcher.ts`'s digest path; doc lines only in `notification-text.ts`), the test, and `.changeset/25015-digest-heading-locale.md`. It does not touch `notification-preference.object.ts`, `preference-resolver.ts` or `packages/spec/**`.
